resumo: Ilustração chapada de quadrinho sobre céu noturno preto pontilhado de estrelas. Traço de nanquim grosso, cores chapadas e poucas por quadro, grão de papel de risografia. Figura solitária de costas contemplando o cosmos, às vezes com um bicho ao lado.
estilo_anterior: Pintura a óleo texturizada em tela de linho, usada nos posts 01 a 15. Ver o commit anterior a esta troca se precisar reproduzir aqueles.
abertura: Flat comic-book illustration, like a single graphic-novel panel. Bold confident black ink linework, screen-print and risograph feel.

figura.padrao: Solitary figure seen from behind, small in frame, face never visible, sitting or standing very still, drawn with heavy ink outlines and flat colour fills.
figura.surreal: A gently whimsical character seen from behind, face never visible, small in frame, sitting or standing very still, drawn with heavy ink outlines and flat colour fills.

luz: No gradients and no soft shading: flat blocks of colour separated by clean ink lines.
materia: Deep black night sky densely hand-stippled with small white stars of varying size, subtle paper grain and print texture, colours flat and slightly muted.
respiro: Wide open empty black sky in the {zona} third of the frame, stars only, no objects, reserved for text overlay.
clima: Cosmic, quiet, contemplative, gently surreal, hopeful.
trava_referencia: Match the ink line weight, flat colour handling, star field density and paper texture of the reference image. Do NOT copy its composition or subject.
negativos: No text, no lettering, no watermark, no signature, no faces, no logos.

paletas.P1: Black sky and white stars, with flat accents of soft teal and pale grey
paletas.P2: Black sky and white stars, with flat accents of crimson red and warm sand
paletas.P3: Black sky and white stars, with flat accents of amber yellow and burnt orange
paletas.P4: Black sky and white stars, with flat accents of emerald green and cobalt blue
